overview.oneLineTake: A triple shock of AI narrative collapse, 5% yields, and an oil-driven energy crisis is forcing a violent repricing of risk across equities, rates, and credit.
themes: AI industry leaders (OpenAI, Anthropic) are publicly calling for a development slowdown, triggering a sharp rotation out of tech and chip stocks.
The 10-year Treasury yield breached 5% for the first time since 2007, driven by persistent inflation, surging oil, and fiscal debt fears.
A multi-front energy crisis is unfolding: Saudi pipeline shut, Strait of Hormuz attacks, record diesel prices, and oil above $100.
risks: Fed is widely expected to hike this week, with some analysts warning of multiple hikes—stagflation risk is rising.
US private credit default rate hit a record 6.3%, signaling stress in lower-quality credit markets.
Geopolitical tail risk is elevated: Houthi missile barrages, Iran drone downing, and potential Saudi export disruption.
